dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin's NFT scene is heating up, but again, can't compare it with Bitcoin's.

The Doginal Dogs and the Doginal Mini Doges have market caps of $23 and $5 million. Compare that to the $300 million of both Runestone and NodeMonkes.

Doge NFTs are (for now) a drip in the bucket. https://t.co/na9tOCDzj3

Dogecoin, being a fork of Bitcoin, can also have doginals! 🐶

The DRC-20 token standard follows Bitcoin's BRC-20 and ordinal tech. On Dogecoin, you've got doginals instead of ordinals, and shibes instead of satoshis. Users can create NFTs by inscribing an elon with metadata.
